ownership.quote: Jarvislabs was founded in 2021 and has served 27,000+ AI developers and 50M+ GPU hours.

stage.note: No accelerator (YC page for the 'jarvislabs' slug returns 404), no Crunchbase/Tracxn record accessible, and no press coverage of a priced round found (TechCrunch/HN/site search all empty). Small team, self-described 'small team' on the careers page, and no investor names anywhere on the site, consistent with a bootstrapped company, but this could not be confirmed either way in the time available.

employees.source: https://jarvislabs.ai/careers (describes itself as a 'small team' without giving a headcount)

note: Founded 2021 (India-based, GPU cloud for AI/ML). Claims 27,000+ developers served and 50M+ GPU hours (llms.txt). Only the client-side CLI/Python SDK is open source; the core platform is closed/proprietary. No evidence of an accelerator, priced funding round, investors, or acquisition was found; could be bootstrapped/self-funded or simply under-covered by press and data aggregators. Buyers should treat funding/ownership status as unconfirmed rather than assume bootstrapped.
